desks.Dividends: Apple goes ex-dividend Thu Nov 12 at $0.27 per quarter, unchanged, payable Nov 16. Microsoft goes ex-dividend Thu Nov 19 at $0.98, the first payment at the raised rate and its 24th consecutive annual increase, payable Dec 10. Nvidia has not yet declared its December dividend; the historical pattern points to a late-November declaration. SPY and QQQ December distributions fall outside the window. Tesla pays no dividend.
desks.Earnings: Nvidia is the only watchlist name reporting in the window, Tue Nov 17 after close, with consensus EPS of $2.49 (Nasdaq, 13 estimates). Options imply a move of about 10.4% (Nov 18 at-the-money straddle $17.52 on a $168.89 underlying), about 2.6 times the 4.0% average absolute reaction of the last eight prints. The stock fell 5.5% today and sits about 30% below its Oct 6 high. Premium into a binary event is to be avoided.
desks.Futures: The November WASDE landed today, bullish for grains: corn yield 179.6 bushels per acre and ending stocks 1.758 billion bushels, both below consensus; soybean ending stocks 300 million bushels, well below the 336 million consensus. Corn rose 12 cents and soybeans 36 cents after the report. The EIA November outlook, also today, puts Brent near $100 per barrel through end-2026, then $77 on average in the fourth quarter of 2027. Next catalysts: API tonight, OPEC Wed Nov 11, EIA weekly report Thu Nov 12 at noon ET.
desks.Parity: Cboe's AM-settled weekly SPX options, symbol SPXO, began trading Mon Nov 9. A box or conversion mixing SPX and SPXO legs across the same expiry is not the same settlement, so the deterministic payoff identity does not apply across the two. No new SPX, SPY, or QQQ parity violation was found this week. The current live SPX box-spread rate is UNVERIFIED.
desks.Premium: All six verdicts are WINDOW-CONTINGENT. The Nov 5 crash day still drives 43-54% of each 20-day realized-variance window (file screen: SPY 62.6%, QQQ 50.4%, AAPL 55.8%, MSFT 45.8%, NVDA 49.3%, TSLA 51.3%). Front IV sits below the jump-polluted realized level for five of six names; only Nvidia is above, and that is earnings-driven. Term structure is upward sloping at every name from 1 to 3 days, with no front-end inversion. IV rank is UNVERIFIED for all six names, no free IV-history source is available. Put-call parity looks intact on the live chains.
desks.Quant lab: Eight new candidates were scored and added to the ledger (#246-253), 4 WATCH, 4 ARCHIVE, with no TEST or INTEGRATE movement. #246 (score 62, WATCH) is a distributional TD3 hedging agent trained on an empirical replay of S&P 500 options 1996-2017 and tested out of sample 2018-2023; source-reported claims are UNVERIFIED, and the edge is regime-conditional per the authors. The lesson for the desk: a hedging agent trained only in simulation misses crash and volatility regimes.

items.detail: Brent fell below $90 per barrel today, about 22% below its Oct 30 high of $118, on de-escalation headlines and OPEC output recovery of 1.38 million barrels per day in October. Yet Hormuz traffic runs at about 8% of normal and Middle East exports are down at least 60%; the curve is still backwardated but spreads narrowed about 30% last week. An IRGC claim today that two tankers caught fire in the strait is UNVERIFIED, single-source state media with no independent confirmation. This is the desk's highest-conviction watch item.
items.title: Oil's war premium is unwinding while Hormuz stays nearly closed

Corn rose 12 cents and soybeans 36 cents after the report. The EIA November outlook, also today, puts Brent near $100 per barrel through end-2026, then $77 on average in the fourth quarter of 2027, and raises the 2027 diesel forecast to $5.03 per gallon, up 12% from October.
